newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $135 mln trade gap first week March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $135 mln trade gap first week March.

text.p: Brazil posted a trade deficit of $135 million in the first week of March, with exports of $962 million and imports $1.097 billion, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
The ministry said average daily exports in the first week of the month were $192.4 million, while average daily imports stood at $219.4 million.
Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, economic policy secretary at the Finance Ministry, told reporters the government would start revealing import and export figures weekly.
